skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 60% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG equal to 12% of each enemy's Max HP to all enemies, then applies a [Mark] to himself.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Direct DMG to all enemies increased to 12% > 16% of their Max HP. The self-[Mark] is upgraded to a stronger version.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gains +20% HP. After any character in his row attacks, triggers [Breakthrough] on the main target. Permanently grants [Immunity against Silence] to his entire row.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Breakthrough] trigger: after any character in his row attacks > after any character around Melzargard attacks.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, grants the entire team 50% Shield Rate, lasts 2 rounds. Triggers [Reborn] after taking fatal damage (When ally is present, recovers 50% HP before action, up to 2 times)

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc:
Shield Rate 50% > 70% Recovers HP before action up to 2x > 3x
[Revive] can be stacked with SSR+ Phoenixman and SSR+ Pig God Revived characters do not get [Specialized Protection] from SSR+ Drive Knight but still can get from their own skills

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
The target cannot use his ultimate. Counts as a control effect.
Mark a unit, unlocking a raid condition or bonus effect associated with the mark.
Status returns downed units to battle, granting a limited number of respawns that anti-revive effects can remove.
Restores Health over time or before the unit's next action.
